purpose: Map the functioning interior of the already-viewed/internal GRI architecture without creating prospective confirmation or changing frozen C1/P0 results.
allowed_evidence: closed Stage C1 outputs after exact state verification
closed legacy predictive P0 DISCOVERY/REPLICATION/FINAL_HOLDOUT outputs
returned post-C1 sensitivity outputs only after their frozen P0-Q execution completes
forbidden_promotions: capacity-matched Hallmark superiority unless separately tested
rare-natural-testbed status based on Engine output

questions.question: How does leading-mode concentration vary across cancers and technical tracks?
questions.operation: Summarize per-cancer modal concentration/effective-rank/leading-mode contributions from preserved outputs; when post-C1 S4 returns, map top-1/top-3 ablation response alongside baseline structure.
questions.expected_information: Whether shared organization is diffuse or concentrated and whether concentration varies continuously across the occupied internal regime.
questions.decision_enabled: Function-map description and candidate reduction-adequacy regions; no confirmatory threshold.

questions.question: Can similar global cross-layer geometry arise from different Hallmark-semantic organizations?
questions.operation: Jointly map global CKA/principal-angle summaries against H3a/H3b module coupling without outcome-based subgroup selection.
questions.expected_information: Whether system-level shared geometry and semantic module correspondence vary semi-independently across cancers.
questions.decision_enabled: Clarify whether multiple internal organizations occupy similar global-geometry regions.

questions.question: How does limited composition projection move cancers through the internal architecture landscape?
questions.operation: Compare raw versus purity/leukocyte-projected scalar/modal/cross-component coordinates using the already-prespecified paired outputs.
questions.expected_information: Context-sensitive versus context-robust regions and modules.
questions.decision_enabled: Function-map context labels; identify richer composition-control hypotheses.

questions.question: Do different internal architecture states produce similar internal predictive risk?
questions.operation: Map preserved DISCOVERY/REPLICATION architecture descriptors against FINAL_HOLDOUT cancer-level risk without tuning a new selector or threshold.
questions.expected_information: Whether prediction performance is many-to-one with respect to internal organization rather than governed by one geometry coordinate.
questions.decision_enabled: Generate future routing/heterogeneity hypotheses; cannot modify P3-v2.

questions.question: Where does scalar compression preserve ordering while modal detail changes?
questions.operation: Compare S_spec ordering with effective-rank, principal-angle, and mode-contribution summaries across cancers/tracks.
questions.expected_information: Information lost by scalar compression inside otherwise functioning regimes.
questions.decision_enabled: Reduction-adequacy annotations and candidate M1 future tests.

questions.question: Which modules are consistently context-sensitive or context-robust?
questions.operation: Map B1/C1 paired raw-adjusted module-level changes with uncertainty, retaining all tested modules rather than selecting favorable examples.
questions.expected_information: Occupied context-response patterns and candidate composition-sensitive sectors.
questions.decision_enabled: Atlas/function-map annotations and future independent composition hypotheses.

questions.question: Does the technical-mask track change only magnitude or also reorganize modal orientation?
questions.operation: Compare paired PRIMARY_PUBLICATION and MASKED_TECHNICAL modal/global geometry summaries and, where available, principal-angle changes.
questions.expected_information: Whether technical masking acts as magnitude attenuation versus structural reorganization.

questions.question: Can cancers be grouped by architecture without using downstream outcomes?
questions.operation: Exploratory unsupervised visualization/clustering on predeclared architecture descriptors only, with stability diagnostics and no clinical labels used to choose clusters.
questions.expected_information: Candidate occupied architecture families independent of downstream outcome labels.
questions.decision_enabled: P0-D hypotheses only; any biological/clinical interpretation requires independent follow-up.

questions.question: Which current WORKS_HERE regions survive the already-frozen post-C1 sensitivity attacks?
questions.operation: After sensitivity return, overlay S1-S7/S11/S12 robustness status on the preexisting Function Map without changing sensitivity rules.
questions.expected_information: Robust, narrowed, failed, and unknown interior regions.
questions.decision_enabled: Update Function/Limit maps and supported production scope before Engine freeze.
